_comment: outline-scan cases. Expected JSON is generated (node tests/outline-fixtures.mjs --update) and reviewed,
never hand-edited. `source` names a corpus file the case is a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy of; null means synthetic.
post-v1/post-v2 are one post in two revisions: v2 moves the third section to first and adds one paragraph.

cases.name: essay.md
cases.why: An argument with three sections, an opening marker in each, citations and numbers.

cases.name: technical.md
cases.why: A reference doc: five short uniform sections; flat is correct here and the scan must not say otherwise.

cases.name: chapter.md
cases.why: Fiction: one heading, scene breaks as thematic breaks, few markers; beat-sheet material.

cases.name: post-v2.md
cases.why: Revision two: a section moved, a paragraph added; the diff fixture pairs with v1.

cases.name: note.md
cases.why: No headings, two paragraphs: not-evaluated, with the reason.

cases.name: flat.txt
cases.why: No ATX headings but many paragraphs: one preamble section, measured.
